articles.title: NASA’s Simulated Mars Crew Marks One Year Inside Habitat
articles.summary: The four crew members in NASA’s simulated Mars mission have spent the past year living and working in isolation in a confined habitat at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston.

articles.title: A Mars-velous decade: Celebrating ten years of TGO
articles.summary: Ten years after arriving at Mars, ESA’s ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter (TGO) has grown far beyond its original ambitions. From revealing the martian atmosphere to becoming a vital communications link with the surface, the mission’s story is also one of adaptability, resilience and the people behind it.

articles.title: Euclid discovers new comet
articles.summary: The European Space Agency’s Euclid space telescope has discovered its first previously unknown comet, in images taken between 16 and 24 September 2026.
